_note: Labeled cases for GreenPath AI. 'pathway' tests the classifier; 'review' tests document review. Add more cases freely — accuracy is only meaningful with coverage. Expected pathway categories: family-based | employment-based | humanitarian | diversity-lottery | investment | low-confidence. For review cases, expectStatus is an OR-set (any match passes) and EVERY string in expectKeywords must appear in the serialized issues (case-insensitive), so keep keywords to a single robust token per case.

pathway.input: I am married to a U.S. citizen. We live together in California. I entered legally on a tourist visa.
My husband is a U.S. citizen. I live in the Philippines and have never been to the US.
My daughter is 27 and a U.S. citizen. She wants to sponsor me to live with her.
I have a PhD in biology and a U.S. university wants to hire me as a research scientist. My employer will sponsor me.
I am an award-winning athlete with international recognition and want to immigrate based on my achievements without an employer.
I work as a welder and my U.S. employer is willing to sponsor me through labor certification (PERM).
I am a researcher whose work benefits the United States and I want to self-petition without a job offer based on a national interest waiver.
I fled my country because I was persecuted for my political opinion and I am afraid to return.
I am married to a U.S. citizen who abuses me. I want to apply on my own without his help.
I was the victim of a serious crime in the US and helped the police investigate it.
I am from Nepal and entered the green card lottery. I was selected this year.
I have 1.2 million dollars to invest in a new U.S. business that will create at least 10 jobs.
My U.S. citizen fiance and I want to marry in the US after I arrive.
I am an international student on an F-1 visa and just want a green card somehow.
pathway.note: Insufficient basis; classifier should set confidence low

pathway.input: I manage a foreign branch of a U.S. multinational company and they want to transfer me permanently to run the U.S. office as an executive.
My wife is a U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder, not a citizen) and wants to sponsor me to immigrate.
I was admitted to the United States as a refugee just over a year ago and now I want to apply for my green card.
pathway.note: Refugee adjustment after 1 year of admission
